board.name: Alfred J. Dansbury, Sr.
board.bio: Degrees from Rutgers University, Eastern University and Rowan University.
board.more:
Taught English in New Jersey and Massachusetts before a 38-year career with the City of Camden's housing services and grants management offices, where he coordinated the federal HOPWA housing program for 14 years.

He was an adjunct instructor at Camden County College and published the novel *The Strength of Courage* in 2022. His education includes a BA in English and Journalism from Rutgers, an MA in Education from Eastern Michigan University, an MA in Business Administration from Eastern University, and an MA in Writing from Rowan University.

board.bio: Researcher, educator, and spoken word artist; Director of Literacy Programming at Flanner House and Director of Power of a Sentence, a creative writing program in Indiana prisons.
board.more: PhD in Literacy, Culture, and Language Education from Indiana University. He has shared his work in more than 30 states. With his wife, he owns Indy Type Shop, a typewriter repair shop, antiquarian bookstore and event space.
